name: com.sniveler-code.gpu-animation-pro
description: High-performance GPU animation system for Unity DOTS/ECS. Features Zero-Latency Weapon Sockets, Full Shader Graph Support, Dual Quaternion Skinning (DQS), and an automated Baking Pipeline. Render 10,000+ animated units with Root Motion and LOD optimization.

samples.description: Demonstrates basic baking, simple movement, and parameter changing via UI.
Showcases the Zero-Latency Socket System with frame-perfect weapon equipping.
Stress test featuring spatial hashing, combat decision-making, and thousands of units.
